build: MRT Pharma MacBook Walkthrough Steering + Final Navigation Acceptance

macbook_steering.MACBOOK_TRACKPAD_FINE_STEERING_ROOT_CAUS: Steering depended on pointer-lock movementX. On Apple trackpads, pointer-lock mouse deltas are unreliable/absent (one-finger motion without a button often yields no mousemove; locked deltas are inconsistent across Safari/Chrome on macOS). The product cannot rely on pointer lock as the only fine-steering path.
macbook_steering.fix: Added continuous, time-based ARROW-KEY yaw (Left/Right) integrated in the update loop (frame-rate independent, no quantization, no OS key-repeat dependence) as the reliable primary steering, PLUS a click-drag look fallback (pointerdown+drag on the canvas -> yaw/pitch, no pointer lock needed). Pointer lock is no longer forced.
macbook_steering.KEYBOARD_YAW_OS_REPEAT_DEPENDENCE: NO (keydown marks active; loop integrates by elapsed time; keyup clears)
macbook_steering.KEYBOARD_PITCH_FALLBACK: DEFERRED_WITH_REASON (drag-look already provides pitch on trackpad; a modifier+arrow pitch mapping deferred to avoid conflicting with accepted arrow-up/down = forward/back)
macbook_steering.TRACKPAD_CONTINUOUS_LOOK: PARTIAL (works when the browser delivers trackpad mousemove; not relied upon)
macbook_steering.TRACKPAD_CLICK_DRAG_LOOK: IMPLEMENTED (pointer down+drag on canvas => first-person yaw/pitch, not orbit)
macbook_steering.MACBOOK_WALKTHROUGH_HELP: YES (W/S Walk · A/D Strafe · <-/-> Turn · Shift Faster · Drag to look · Esc release)

offline_tests.KEYBOARD_STEERING_COLLISION_PIPELINE_TES: PASS (translation after yaw still passes through resolveWalkCollision)
